@case('题库与提示浏览器验证', '浏览器模拟非JSON/网络错误；创建空题库，从自己的问卷复制题目，重复保存，加入另一题库。',

def test_bank_copy_and_readable_errors(client):
    pw=pytest.importorskip('playwright.sync_api')
    h=login(client);sid,qs=survey_with_questions(client,h,[question_input('number',title='问卷中的年龄',min_value=0,max_value=120)])
    other=login(client,'other');survey_with_questions(client,other,[question_input('text',title='他人的私有题目')])
    token=h['Authorization'].removeprefix('Bearer ')
    sock=socket.socket();sock.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));origin=f'http://127.0.0.1:{sock.getsockname()[1]}'
    server=uvicorn.Server(uvicorn.Config(create_app(Settings(mongo_uri='mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017',database=client.app.state.db.name)),log_level='error'))
    thread=threading.Thread(target=server.run,kwargs={'sockets':[sock]},daemon=True);thread.start()
    try:
        for _ in range(100):
            if server.started: break
            time.sleep(.1)
        assert server.started
        with pw.sync_playwright() as p:
            browser=p.chromium.launch(channel='msedge',headless=True);page=browser.new_page()
            page.add_init_script('sessionStorage.setItem("survey_token",'+json.dumps(token)+')')
            errors=[];page.on('pageerror',lambda e:errors.append(str(e)))
            page.goto(origin);pw.expect(page.locator('#banks')).to_be_visible()
            for status,ctype,body in [(500,'text/plain','Internal Server Error'),(503,'text/html','<html>Unavailable</html>'),
                (500,'application/json','Invalid JSON'),(422,'application/json','{"detail":[{"msg":"Field required","loc":["body","title"]}]}'),
                (400,'application/json','{"detail":"Traceback internal_error"}')]:
                page.route('**/api/question-banks',lambda route,request,status=status,ctype=ctype,body=body:route.fulfill(status=status,content_type=ctype,body=body))
                page.locator('#notice').evaluate('(el)=>el.textContent=""')
                page.locator('#banks').click();pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).not_to_be_empty()
                message=page.locator('#notice').inner_text()
                assert re.search('[\u3400-\u9fff]',message) and not re.search('[A-Za-z_{}\[\]0-9]',message)
                page.unroute('**/api/question-banks')
            page.route('**/api/question-banks',lambda route:route.abort())
            page.locator('#banks').click();pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('无法连接')
            page.unroute('**/api/question-banks')
            page.locator('#banks').click();page.locator('#newBank').click();page.locator('#bankName').fill('第一个库')
            page.get_by_role('button',name='保存题库').click();page.locator('[data-bank]').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#noCandidates')).to_contain_text('从我的问卷选择题目')
            assert page.locator('#existingFamily').count()==0
            page.locator('#copyFromSurvey').click()
            assert page.locator('#sourceSurvey option').count()==2
            page.locator('#sourceSurvey').select_option(sid)
            pw.expect(page.locator('#sourceQuestions')).to_contain_text('数字范围：0～120')
            page.locator('[data-copy-question]').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('原问卷保持不变')
            pw.expect(page.locator('[data-family]')).to_have_count(1)
            page.locator('#copyFromSurvey').click();page.locator('#sourceSurvey').select_option(sid);page.locator('[data-copy-question]').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('无需重复保存')
            page.locator('#back').click();page.locator('#newBank').click();page.locator('#bankName').fill('第二个库')
            page.get_by_role('button',name='保存题库').click();page.locator('[data-bank]').last.click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#existingFamily option')).to_have_count(1)
            page.get_by_role('button',name='加入当前题库',exact=True).click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('已加入')
            assert page.locator('#existingFamily').count()==0
            assert client.app.state.db.bank_questions.count_documents({})==1
            assert client.app.state.db.question_versions.count_documents({})==1
            assert client.app.state.db.surveys.find_one({'_id':sid})['questions']==qs
            assert errors==[],errors
            browser.close()
    finally:
        server.should_exit=True;thread.join(timeout=10);sock.close()
        assert not thread.is_alive()

@case('认证浏览器自动化', '登录页进入注册页并返回；验证必填、格式、密码长度、一致性和重复账号；注册后登录、退出；分享链接上注册登录。',

def test_separate_auth_views(client):
    pw = pytest.importorskip('playwright.sync_api')
    _, sid, _ = setup_survey(client)
    sock = socket.socket(); sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
    origin = f'http://127.0.0.1:{sock.getsockname()[1]}'
    app = create_app(Settings(mongo_uri='mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017', database=client.app.state.db.name))
    server = uvicorn.Server(uvicorn.Config(app, log_level='error'))
    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.run, kwargs={'sockets': [sock]}, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    try:
        for _ in range(100):
            if server.started: break
            time.sleep(.1)
        assert server.started
        with pw.sync_playwright() as p:
            browser = p.chromium.launch(channel='msedge', headless=True)
            page = browser.new_page()
            errors = []; requests = []
            page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
            page.on('request', lambda r: requests.append(r.url) if r.url.endswith('/api/auth/register') else None)
            page.goto(origin)
            pw.expect(page.locator('#auth')).to_be_visible()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#confirmPassword')).to_have_count(0)
            page.locator('#register').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#auth')).to_have_count(0)
            pw.expect(page.locator('#registration')).to_be_visible()
            page.locator('#backToLogin').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#auth')).to_be_visible()
            page.locator('#register').click()
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('请填写')
            page.locator('#username').fill('!bad')
            page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#confirmPassword').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('用户名须')
            page.locator('#username').fill('ui_user')
            page.locator('#password').fill('short')
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('密码长度')
            page.locator('#password').fill('x'*17)
            page.locator('#confirmPassword').fill('x'*17)
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('8～16个字符')
            page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#confirmPassword').fill('different')
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('不一致')
            assert requests == []
            page.locator('#confirmPassword').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('注册成功')
            pw.expect(page.locator('#auth')).to_be_visible()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#password')).to_have_value('')
            assert page.evaluate("sessionStorage.getItem('survey_token')") is None
            page.locator('#register').click()
            page.locator('#username').fill('UI_USER')
            page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#confirmPassword').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('用户名已存在')
            assert client.app.state.db.users.count_documents({'username': 'ui_user'}) == 1
            page.locator('#backToLogin').click()
            page.locator('#username').fill('ui_user'); page.locator('#password').fill('incorrect')
            page.get_by_role('button', name='登录', exact=True).click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('用户名或密码错误')
            page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.get_by_role('button', name='登录', exact=True).click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#new')).to_be_visible()
            old_token = page.evaluate("sessionStorage.getItem('survey_token')")
            page.locator('#logout').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#auth')).to_be_visible()
            assert page.evaluate("sessionStorage.getItem('survey_token')") is None
            assert client.get('/api/auth/me', headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+old_token}).status_code == 401
            page.goto(origin+'/survey/'+sid)
            page.locator('#register').click()
            page.locator('#username').fill('share_reader'); page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#confirmPassword').fill('password123'); page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('注册成功')
            assert page.url == origin+'/survey/'+sid
            page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.get_by_role('button', name='登录', exact=True).click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#answerForm')).to_be_visible()
            from app.auth import digest, now
            import secrets
            salt = secrets.token_hex(16)
            client.app.state.db.users.insert_one({'_id':'browser_legacy','username':'browser_legacy',
                'salt':salt,'password_hash':digest('L'*128,salt),'created_at':now()})
            page.locator('#logout').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#auth')).to_be_visible()
            page.locator('#username').fill('browser_legacy')
            page.locator('#password').fill('L'*128)
            page.get_by_role('button',name='登录',exact=True).click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#answerForm')).to_be_visible()
            assert errors == [], errors
            browser.close()
    finally:
        server.should_exit = True; thread.join(timeout=10); sock.close()
        assert not thread.is_alive()

@case('第二阶段浏览器自动化', 'Edge中创建题库/题目、分支/恢复、分享/撤销；选题加入问卷、换版、发布填写、查使用及统计。', '数字题年龄、答案16，reader共享账号，390px视窗', '页面流程完成；三版本；快照换版成功；统计16；使用清单可见；无JS异常和横向溢出。')
def test_library_browser_flow(client):
    playwright = pytest.importorskip('playwright.sync_api')
    login(client,'reader')
    sock=socket.socket();sock.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));port=sock.getsockname()[1]
    settings=Settings(mongo_uri='mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017',database=client.app.state.db.name)
    server=uvicorn.Server(uvicorn.Config(create_app(settings),log_level='error'))
    thread=threading.Thread(target=server.run,kwargs={'sockets':[sock]},daemon=True);thread.start()
    try:
        for _ in range(100):
            if server.started: break
            time.sleep(.1)
        assert server.started
        with playwright.sync_playwright() as p:
            browser=p.chromium.launch(channel='msedge',headless=True)
            page=browser.new_page(viewport={'width':1280,'height':900})
            errors=[];page.on('pageerror',lambda e:errors.append(str(e)))
            page.goto(f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}')
            page.locator('#register').click()
            page.locator('#username').fill('browser_phase2');page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#confirmPassword').fill('password123');page.locator('#submitRegistration').click();playwright.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('注册成功')
            page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.get_by_role('button',name='登录',exact=True).click()
            page.locator('#banks').click();page.locator('#newBank').click()
            page.locator('#bankName').fill('课堂题库');page.get_by_role('button',name='保存题库').click()
            page.locator('[data-bank]').click();page.locator('#newBankQuestion').click()
            page.locator('#qt').fill('年龄');page.locator('#kind').select_option('number')
            page.locator('#integer').check();page.get_by_role('button',name='保存题目').click()
            page.locator('[data-family]').click();page.locator('[data-branch]').first.click()
            page.locator('#qt').fill('年龄第二版');page.get_by_role('button',name='保存题目').click()
            playwright.expect(page.locator('[data-version-row]')).to_have_count(2)
            page.locator('[data-restore]').first.click()
            playwright.expect(page.locator('[data-version-row]')).to_have_count(3)
            page.locator('#shareUsername').fill('reader');page.get_by_role('button',name='分享题目',exact=True).click()
            playwright.expect(page.locator('[data-revoke]')).to_have_count(1)
            page.locator('[data-revoke]').click();playwright.expect(page.locator('[data-revoke]')).to_have_count(0)
            page.locator('#back').click();page.locator('#back').click()
            page.locator('#new').click();page.locator('#title').fill('题库复用演示')
            page.locator('#anonymous').check();page.get_by_role('button',name='保存',exact=True).click()
            page.locator('#importLibrary').click();page.locator('[data-family]').click();page.locator('[data-pick]').first.click()
            page.locator('[data-switch]').click();page.locator('[data-family]').click();page.locator('[data-pick]').last.click()
            page.locator('#publish').click();playwright.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('已发布')
            share=page.locator('a[href^="/survey/"]').get_attribute('href')
            page.goto(f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}'+share);page.locator('#answer').fill('16')
            page.get_by_role('button',name='下一步').click();page.locator('#submit').click()
            playwright.expect(page.get_by_role('heading',name='提交成功')).to_be_visible()
            page.goto(f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}');page.locator('[data-open]').click();page.locator('[data-cross]').click()
            playwright.expect(page.locator('#app')).to_contain_text('平均值：16')
            page.locator('#versionFilter').select_option(index=3)
            playwright.expect(page.locator('#app')).to_contain_text('平均值：16')
            page.screenshot(path='test-results/phase2/browser-library-stats.png',full_page=True)
            page.set_viewport_size({'width':390,'height':844})
            assert page.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth')
            page.locator('#back').click();page.locator('#banks').click();page.locator('[data-family]').first.click();page.locator('#usages').click()
            playwright.expect(page.locator('#app')).to_contain_text('题库复用演示')
            assert errors==[],errors
            browser.close()
    finally:
        server.should_exit=True;thread.join(timeout=10);sock.close()
        assert not thread.is_alive()
